events.title: MTV's 45th Anniversary
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its inaugural music video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw a music video on MTV? Forty-five years ago today, it all began with The Buggles. How did MTV change music for you?

events.title: Oasis 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis' groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' was originally released on August 29, 1994, an anniversary we mark this month.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Twenty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. What's your standout track from an album that defined a generation?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, an iconic moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock Spirit
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, hundreds of thousands gathered for Woodstock. Peace, music, and mud – what a vibe! Wish you were there?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today since we lost Elvis Presley. His music continues to influence generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Today, we remember the life and legacy of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas in September 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Three decades on, Tupac Shakur's lyrics and impact remain as powerful as ever. Remembering a true legend today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We pay tribute today to the unparalleled talent of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi's Genius
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since Jimi Hendrix left us, but his guitar mastery still sounds as revolutionary as ever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album, originally released on September 26, 1969, is a timeless classic we're celebrating this month.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: That zebra crossing, that album. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57 this month. Still one of the most recognisable covers ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie's Influence
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon whose voice and attitude continue to inspire. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad For It Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine', released as a single in the UK in 1975, is a powerful message we reflect on today.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' single hit the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Today, we look back at the launch of the original Apple iPod, which revolutionised portable music after its release in October 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. What was your first iPod?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music icon John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, what's your favourite moment of his comedic genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, known as 'The White Album', originally released on November 22, 1968, is remembered today.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your top track from it?
